question: Identify an allotrope of carbon that is smooth and slippery.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Graphite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Graphite is an allotrope of carbon that is known for its smooth and slippery texture.
 
• This characteristic makes graphite useful as a **lubricant and as the "lead" in pencils**.</li&g
